unsupported: Finwave Semiconductor, headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, traces its roots to 2012 when Cambridge Electronics was founded by MIT professor Tomás Palacios to commercialize GaN-on-Si research from his laboratory.
As a fabless semiconductor company, Finwave designs RF switches and power amplifiers using its proprietary FinFET-based GaN-on-Si process.

Known for: Patented device-level linearization for PAs and LNAs reducing electron-trapping effects; FinFET-based GaN-on-Si process enabling Moore’s Law scaling to RF; High intrinsic linearity improving PA efficiency at backoff and simplifying DPD; E-mode GaN-on-Si design for lower cost of ownership and simplified circuitry; 100% wafer-level and packaged-device testing with HTOL reliability screening
